status: Design review; approximations are deliberate, not claims of runtime support.

entries.conversion: Use the normal melee profile and common Attack rules; omit PF2e action-scaled damage and footprint saves.
Use the normal ranged profile and Volley rules; preserve ranged identity without adding an ability.
Use the game's existing withdrawal activity and its contact rules; omit the separate PF2e safe half-Stride.
Use the single-unit hex abstraction; omit individual troop segments.
Use imported movement modes and game Move; omit free segment reshaping.
Paid two-action Recovery for self or one adjacent ally, Health mode. Omit Medicine DC tiers, dice, critical-failure damage, and healer-specific hourly immunity; use the catalogue limit.
Cavalry Charge. Omit the source critical-failure knockdown and extra PF2e movement.
Two-action non-damaging Volley replacement: on a successful game attack check, Suppress. Omit graded save outcomes and Speed penalties; this grants no normal Volley damage.
Share Guard with one adjacent ally. Omit anti-flanking geometry and level-scaled fortified bonuses.
One-action Menace against one visible enemy within two hexes, resolved with a Will resistance check at the unit's normal ability DC. Omit Intimidation proficiency and ten-minute immunity.
A successful melee hit applies Menace. Omit separate frightened grades.
Keep the successful-rout-resistance trigger; use Counterplay in the future reaction system.
One-action Expose against an adjacent enemy, using a game attack check against Will. Omit Deception and Perception skills and per-attack save penalties.
Use Shielding with the ordinary Guard activity and a shield requirement. Omit the extra physical-ranged bonus.
Future Retaliate; preserve the triggering activity as a prerequisite. It is not a passive extra attack.
Future Block requires a shield and raised protection. Omit the source Hardness value.
Vanguard only when acting before all enemies. Omit Stealth initiative and the first-attack DC bonus. This replaces rather than adds to the existing Ambush deployment abstraction.
Choose Pathfinder for ordinary ground or Shielding when assigning the card; grant one of them. Omit the round-by-round choice to keep one clear specialty.
Exploit: +1 Defence while at half Health or less. Omit Battle and save bonuses and level scaling.
Grant the same paid Recovery activity as Battlefield Medicine, once. The grant and its child item must not create two healing allowances.
At the start of one adjacent ally's activation, grant Vitality while the commander is active. Omit the 60-foot multi-target reach and level scaling; use the shared recipient limit.
Campaign food logistics; no tactical ability.
Pathfinder: woods. Preserve the movement specialty; omit plant/fungus taxonomy.
Shielding through Guard; omit a separate formation state and PF2e save modifiers.
Exploit: +1 on the Menace check granted by Demoralize. This requires Menace and grants no second frightening activity.
Resolve: fear resistance. Omit the additional frightened-value reduction.
The game has no troop ammunition depletion; the common abstraction already absorbs this benefit.
Adjacent allies gain Resolve: fear resistance while the banner unit is active. Omit initiative and frightened-value reduction.
Exploit: +1 initiative. Omit detailed Seek and perception bonuses.

Exploit: +1 melee on a three-action attack, if that investment exists in the chosen game activity. Otherwise suggest Exploit on the first melee attack and require explicit assignment. Do not silently invent a three-action attack or extra Salvo.
Future Pursue follows a departing engaged enemy. Preserve legal movement modes.
Resolve: hold ground. Omit fleeing-to-slowed conversion. Never map this source to pursuit.
The display name is Reposition: Vanguard only when acting before all enemies. This grants movement, not an opening shot.
The display name is Aggressive Mounts: Exploit melee against unmounted troops. Omit individual-size predicates, low-level defensive drawbacks, and level scaling. It grants no forced movement.
Siege Crew. Omit combined Aim/Launch and expert proficiency; merge with other crew training into one bonus.
Siege Crew. Omit the load-action discount; merge with other crew training into one bonus.
Future Battle Recovery after a critical melee result. Actual Health recovery remains distinct from temporary Vitality.
Vehicle control and firing penalties lie outside this tactical catalogue. Preserve the source text.
Grant Shielding while carrying shields; record future Block separately. Deduplicate the Raise Shields and Shield Block child items.
Use Shielding through Guard. Omit a separate cover tier, Take Cover escalation, and hiding restrictions.
Siege Crew. Omit proficiency ranks and source Launch DC formula.
The commander spends two actions; one adjacent ally spends its reaction to Move. The source is a paid activity with recipient reactions, so defer the whole command until reactions exist.
Two-action Vitality for one adjacent ally. Omit the 60-foot group effect and one-minute duration; it does not restore Health.
Pathfinder: rough ground. Omit separate rubble, sand, and debris classifications.
At activation start, condition-mode Recovery once per battle. Omit the DC 15 flat check. Explicit start timing is a restricted exception to the normal paid/rider Recovery deliveries.
Cavalry Charge with Expose on a critical melee hit. Omit the alternative mass Demoralize/Trip checks and separate Move activity.
Preserve the source HP in import evidence and existing stat conversion; add no fifth Health box. A small PF2e HP bonus may disappear at this scale.
Cavalry Charge plus Sweep after a successful Charge. Omit movement through occupied troop spaces and attacks against every traversed creature.
Exploit: +1 Defence against ranged attacks. Omit the separate Salvo save bonus.
Campaign pay logistics; no tactical ability.
Campaign garrison logistics; no tactical ability.
Future Hold Nerve while not routed. Omit the source next-check bonus.
Pathfinder: water and swamp. Use actual imported swim capability; this ability grants none. Omit terrain-conditioned skill and Battle bonuses.
Resolve: fear resistance. Merge duplicate bravery bonuses.
After melee damage, apply Menace if the target fails a Will resistance check. Use the unit's normal game ability DC; omit fixed DC 24 and fear grades.
Critical melee hit applies Lingering Harm with the fire tag. Omit source persistent damage dice.
Adjacent hostile Menace aura. The registry version is passive; omit its separate Demoralize grant and fear-save penalty rather than creating three benefits.
Retain the death-explosion identity for a later death-trigger proposal. Do not approximate it with Sweep or add a custom one-creature callback now.
Cavalry Charge once per battle. Omit doubled PF2e Speed; retain the limited-use identity.

Two-action non-damaging Volley replacement: a successful game attack check applies Snare. This replaces the source slowed/action penalty and Escape DC with a movement restriction and one-action release.
Retain as a spell-catalogue choice. The random multi-condition table does not justify five troop-specific ability branches.
Shared occupancy needs a different board model. Preserve the source description and grant no substitute bonus.
Vanguard when deployed in water or swamp. Respect legal movement and finish outside contact. Omit adjacent-enemy deployment and first-round Battle bonus.
Critical melee or Volley hit applies Suppression. This deliberately broadens a one-turn enfeebled penalty into one existing game condition.
Pathfinder: water and swamp. Omit the water-battle initiative bonus. The source does not grant water walking.
Successful melee hit applies Lingering Harm with the poison tag. Omit the linked enfeebled penalty and separate poison stages; no extra save.
Use the ordinary ranged profile; omit source burst geometry and action count.
Use the ordinary ranged profile; omit source action count.
Pathfinder: urban ground. Omit segment fitting through narrow streets.
Use the ordinary melee profile.
Using the melee attack grants self Shielding until the next activation. It still grants protection on a miss; omit the separate +1 PF2e AC value.
Assign Shielding as the unit's formation specialty. Omit switching among loose, column, and wedge formations; this is a deliberate selection, not an exact conversion of every formation.
Cavalry Charge with the game's normal route and action rules.
Shared-space movement would change the board model; preserve the source description.
A successful melee hit Exposes its target. Omit the follow-up Athletics Trip check.
Use the ordinary short ranged profile.
The attack's friendly-fire drawback needs explicit target selection. Keep ordinary attack numbers, flag the omitted drawback, and grant no bonus.
Use the ordinary melee profile.
After dealing melee damage, spend one action to grant one adjacent ally Exploit on its next attack before the source's next activation. Omit source range and +3 scaling.
Cavalry Charge. Omit the additional ten feet and source three-action movement sequence.
Use ordinary melee stats and source damage tags. Omit reach and physical-damage-type selection as extra abilities.
Use ordinary melee stats; omit ten-foot individual reach.
Use the troop's role and imported movement. Omit mixed rider/mount spell-target accounting.
Resolve: hold ground, same as No Retreat. Omit the stronger source distance reduction and fleeing-to-slowed conversion.
Exploit: +1 melee against an Exposed target. Substitute the existing Exposed state for source prone/clumsy interaction.
Cavalry Charge; Expose on a successful hit while Shielding was active before the charge. Preserve the formation prerequisite as a game Guard requirement; omit straight-line PF2e segment geometry.
Use the imported ranged profile. Omit the second range/burst tradeoff as an additional ability.
Mark one enemy before battle; Exploit +1 melee against that quarry. This deliberately replaces detailed tracking Perception with a battlefield hunting specialty.
The registry wording affects all nearby creatures. Keep attack numbers and flag the friendly-fire clause for review; do not assume enemies-only behavior from another source version.
Use the ordinary ranged profile.
Permanent action loss is a major drawback. Preserve and flag it; decide a common Sluggish drawback before importing this unit as mechanically complete. Do not quietly turn it into reduced movement.
Use the ordinary melee profile.
Use the ordinary melee profile and imported mounted role.
Pathfinder: all ordinary ground. Preserve barriers and hazards.
Use the game's spell shapes and caster import. Omit PF2e troop area expansion as a second area bonus.
Random confusion changes player control. Preserve as a candidate Unreliable drawback; do not add random-turn rules to the first catalogue.
Retain the self-damage drawback as a review item. Keep attack numbers but grant no extra damage until a common Reckless drawback is defined.
Adjacent allied Resolve: fear resistance. Omit the initiative bonus and source radius. Deduplicate Inspiring Banner.
Adjacent allies gain Exploit on melee attacks against unholy targets. Omit the separate AC and flat damage bonuses; retain the unholy predicate rather than generalizing to undead.
Adjacent allies gain Exploit on attacks while the commander is active. Omit the separate damage bonus and larger source radius.

Adjacent hostile Menace aura. This intentionally replaces a campaign Demoralized floor with temporary tactical fear; it never writes campaign disorder or blocks campaign recovery. Preserve fear immunity.
Share Shielding with one adjacent ally while guarding. Omit the always-on group save bonus. This source is a protective aura, not the game's morale-restoring Rally activity.
Future Block only against an incoming physical critical hit. Omit the DC 17 flat check and critical-to-normal conversion; preserve this prerequisite even though shield equipment is unnecessary.

generatedRules: ReignMaker generates Troop Defenses from HP thresholds outside the 97-entry registry. Classify it as baseline: use Battlefield’s single hex and four-Health abstraction. Form Up and Troop Movement already appear in the registry. Omit segment loss, individual-target immunity, and formation resizing; preserve source HP and traits as evidence.
importFindings: ReignMaker is supplementary evidence. The broader saved review contains 200 source actors and 1,384 actions; Siphoning Grip and regeneration inform the catalogue even though the registry has no corresponding definition.

Training copies system.slug to action items, but the creature ability builder copies name and mechanics without preserving that slug. Read mechanics and portable explicit assignments; actor names, item names, slugs, and UUIDs are recognition hints only.

Doctrine grants include five effect items and one reaction action. Inspect both item types. Actor slugs use doctrine-ability- followed by the grant ID; the snapshot saves that value and the underlying definition.
The actual doctrine code requires dominance for all six grants. The older doctrine reference document differs from current definitions; use the saved code and item text as evidence.

Keep source action, passive, and reaction economy in the audit. A proposed abstraction may deliberately change a passive into a paid Guard effect, but must label that change. Signal the Advance requires recipient reactions despite being a paid source action.

Prepared Foundry statistics may already include rule-element bonuses. Deduplicate imported bonuses against prepared stats before applying Exploit, Resolve, or auras; never add a modifier just because its ability text survived.
Bundle children and parent tactics collapse to one assignment. Examples include Combat Medics/Battlefield Medicine, Shield Discipline/Raise Shields, and the three siege crew training abilities.
Abstracted means a proposed shared game effect, not implemented support. Deferred entries retain an explicit review note; omitted and baseline entries add no new ability.
Keep historical source text, exact hashes, and deliberate omissions. Persist selected catalogue IDs, trigger, local attack attachment, prerequisites, and flavor label separately from source identity.
